scope: Semantic review of every candidate in diagnostic-audit-inventory.json. Original locations/counts are historical, not current source positions. A completed diagnostic family does not mean the whole file is complete. Already useful diagnostics need no edit.

code4004.c.review_notes: Both historical candidates improved in tranche 31; JCN page rejection now uses accurate 1910. Adjacent ISZ page check gains target location. Encoding and predicates retained.

code42c00.c.review_notes: Tranche 32: allowed operand syntax respects CMOS-only P recognition; port overflow gives actual selected CPU interval. Masks, evaluation order and encodings unchanged.

Preserve field/page masks, literal allocation, flags and accepted encodings. Adjacent field/current-page messages improved in tranche 55: actual and required PC/IB fields, and both permitted zero/current-page intervals.

code61860.c.review_notes: All historical branch range/direction candidates improved in tranche 28, plus failed-evaluation cascade fix.

codefmc8.c.review_notes: All six historical sites reviewed in tranche 89: mask-specific registers/direct/extended/indexed/immediate forms with byte/word domains, bit address:bit syntax, A/IX-only stack register choices, signed 16-bit wrapped branch displacement [-128,127] at PC+2/+3. Quoted colon bit-address splitting is a separately reproduced follow-up.

codehmcs400.c.review_notes: Tranche 38: three historical candidates now state actual RAM interval, mask-specific forms, or CA bit operand. Existing IDs, CPU limits, size selection and unknown-symbol predicate retained; stale-mode bug handled separately in tranche 37.

codekcp3.c.review_notes: All historical fixed operand constraint candidates improved in tranche 27; existing IDs and evaluation/encoding behavior retained.

codekcpsm.c.review_notes: Tranche 34: sole historical candidate now lists actual operand mask forms and locates the rejected operand. Tranche 35 separately fixes CALL immediate-mask typo with both syntax forms tested.

codenano.c.review_notes: All historical fixed operand constraint candidates improved in tranche 27; existing IDs and evaluation/encoding behavior retained.

codeol40.c.review_notes: All five historical sites reviewed in tranche 53: mask-specific forms after CPU pruning, C-only one-operand bit forms, and zero-only LD T/LTI/THB restrictions with actual value. LD T retains Byte normalization; LTI retains evaluated signed value for detail. Shared CPU/page helpers already supply their contracts. Separate stale-mode fix in tranche 52.

codeol50.c.review_notes: All seven historical sites reviewed in tranche 68: mask-specific forms, @expr indirect requirement, zero-page PAGE restriction, RDAR/MVAR modifier choices, and CPU-direction branch ranges at PC+1. Adjacent 2090 exposes actual bits7..4 selector and ASSUME P instead of claiming a full-page interval (6052 intentionally retains higher-bit aliasing). Preserve data integer types, original page-mask behavior, IDs, flags and accepted bytes. Separate branch/JMPIO fixes in tranches 65-67.

codepalm.c.review_notes: All five historical sites reviewed in tranche 56: actual full/half update counts and byte/word rules, mask-specific forms, instruction alignment and BRA/RCALL signed displacement constraints. InvOpSize default is unreachable through current callers (all pass 8/16-bit sizes); retain defensive fallback. Adjacent zero-displacement and operand-alignment diagnostics improved too. Preserve modifier grammar, padding, branch flags and JMP silent relaxation.

codepdk.c.review_notes: All seven historical candidates reviewed in tranche 80: two mode sites list mask-specific memory/IO/immediate/accumulator and I/O-bit forms; typed address upper failures show value and selected segment interval; bit counts use count helper and missing structure bit syntax gives element.bit / element,bit detail. Third OverRange is unreachable for current CPUs: RAM/IO limits are Byte, so AutoIntType remains Int8 and expression evaluation guarantees [-128,255] before its repeated check. Preserve this guard and all existing typed/explicit/first-pass behavior. Separate silent accumulator-pair rejection fixed in tranche 79.

codepseudo.c.review_notes: Both custom equate range failures improved in tranche 25, preserving IDs and the 32-bit-host range exemption.

codescmp.c.review_notes: All seven historical sites reviewed in tranches 76/78: redundant pointer caller errors removed, typed register choices, required non-auto address forms, non-PC auto pointer and E-displacement forms, signed 12-bit wrapped PC-relative address distance/full interval/actual page-local PC base. Preserve PC preincrement, page wrapping, typed/numeric aliases and existing IDs. Separate forward-expression rejection fixed in tranche 77.

codest6.c.review_notes: All seven historical sites reviewed in tranche 85: warning 110 ROM-window page versus ROMBASE (including NOTHING), JP/CALL target page versus allowed source/PRPR pages; byte DATA value/full interval; mask-specific forms preserving register aliases; signed 16-bit wrapped 5-/8-bit branch distance and PC+1/+3; BIT count helper. Preserve warning severity/emitted bytes and page selection. Separate signed address, backward-shift UB and provisional-branch bugs fixed in tranches 82/83/84.

codetbil.c.review_notes: Both historical candidates improved in tranche 29. Signed-character translation and unchecked unmapped result fixed separately in tranche 30.

codevector.c.review_notes: All historical candidates improved in tranche 26, plus adjacent PIC CALL bit-8 and SVEC coordinate alignment checks. Encoding and operand evaluation retained.

followups.reason: decode_brset_brclr_core tests ArgStr[2] for X/D[X], ignoring arg_index for suffix bit syntax. Verify and fix separately from branch-message-only tranche.
followups.status: fixed in tranche 22

followups.reason: Signed high-bit input to as_chartrans_xlate yields -1, which bypasses the 7-bit range check and encodes 0xff. Reproduced pc "\128" => 24ff with success. Cast source byte to unsigned char and reject unmapped results.
followups.status: fixed in tranche 30

followups.issue: CALL uses ModImm ordinal instead of MModImm mask, rejecting #target despite its encoder handling immediate targets.
followups.status: fixed in tranche 35; all five CALL conditions and UInt8 endpoints verified

followups.issue: DecodeAdr retains preceding operand/instruction mode after evaluation or RAM range failure, causing secondary errors or stale-mode encoding.
followups.status: fixed in tranche 37; reset mode before every decode, accepted bytes and primary failures verified

followups.issue: DecodeALU probes source with MustBeReg=True before its immediate fallback, emitting errors for supported immediate operands and duplicate errors for rotate forms.
followups.status: fixed in tranche 41; optional register probe restores existing immediate encoder and single rotate rejection

followups.issue: Int4 negative shift count was converted to Word then used in 1 << count, invoking undefined shift behavior.
followups.status: fixed in tranche 43; preserve signed count and reject outside [0,15] before mask shift

followups.issue: CALT first-pass unknown target is forced to 0xc0, below minimum 0xd0, rejecting forward references before resolution.
followups.status: fixed in tranche 47; provisional target forced into [0xd0,0xff], forward endpoints and resolved errors verified

followups.issue: DecodeAdr retains the preceding operand mode when expression evaluation fails, producing secondary mode errors or stale-mode encoding.
followups.status: fixed in tranche 52; initialize ModNone on entry, single primary failures and accepted bytes verified

followups.issue: Code_branch_core ignores failed target evaluation and diagnoses/encodes its provisional result, causing secondary alignment/range errors.
followups.status: fixed in tranche 57; return before branch checks on failed evaluation, all three callers verified

followups.issue: Long-branch Delta -= 2 can overflow signed 32-bit arithmetic after a valid UInt32 target produces INT32_MIN short displacement.
followups.status: fixed in tranche 58; perform correction with unsigned 32-bit arithmetic before restoring signed distance, preserving wrap semantics

followups.issue: Long automatic branch prefix uses 0x0f00 whereas other long-immediate encoders use 0xf000; verify against authoritative XS1 encoding before changing.
followups.status: fixed in tranche 60; XS1 manual pp. 65/234 specifies 111100 prefix bits, automatic forward/backward branches now match explicit displacement encoders

followups.issue: Automatic long branches reject positive byte displacement 131070 even though XS1 permits the full unsigned 16-bit halfword displacement 65535 in either direction.
followups.status: fixed in tranche 61; positive byte displacement 131070 now accepted and agrees with explicit 65535-halfword encoders, next value still rejected

followups.issue: DecodeOP uppercases a component with operands but not a bare component, rejecting lowercase OP dpinc although OP DPINC works.
followups.status: fixed in tranche 64; normalize every initial OP component, lowercase/mixed-case bare components now match uppercase encodings

followups.issue: DecodeJMPIO tests positive ChkArgCnt in an empty if, bypassing CPU/@ checks for valid arity; unconditional decoding then strips any first character, accepting JMPIO 12 as @2.
followups.status: fixed in tranche 65; reject invalid count/prefix before decoding, valid JMP/JMPIO indirect bytes preserved

followups.issue: DecodeRel ignores failed target evaluation, causing secondary 1370 after 1320 for MSM5054 BEQ 1024 and potentially encoding provisional values.
followups.status: fixed in tranche 66; return after failed target evaluation, all five CPUs retain only their primary type/range error

followups.issue: Forward-only MSM5054/5055/5056 branches reject first-pass unknown target placeholder 0 as negative PC+1 displacement, preventing forward labels from resolving.
followups.status: fixed in tranche 67; defer range rejection while target is first-pass unknown or questionable, forward labels now resolve on all CPUs

followups.issue: Branch range checks reject provisional distances of first-pass unknown forward expressions such as target+1000 before the eventual target can resolve within range.
followups.status: fixed in tranche 69; retain flags in regular branches and defer unknown/questionable range checks in regular, bit-test and DJNZ decoders

followups.issue: DecodeCond reports unknown/conflicting conditions but returns a valid encoding; duplicate condition position indexes beyond the argument list.
followups.status: fixed in tranche 72; return NOCONDITION immediately at the offending operand and suppress encoding in branch/return/XC callers; EXPECT regressions prove no words emitted

followups.issue: DecodeLDI inverts Error after both invalid destination and expression evaluation, turning an invalid destination into success and emitting a zero load.
followups.status: fixed in tranche 73; invert expression success only after expression evaluation; failed destination remains an error and suppresses following components and emission

followups.issue: SETSVL/SETSVR values 47..63 set the internal Error flag but issue no diagnostic, silently dropping the instruction while assembly succeeds.
followups.status: fixed in tranche 74; issue positioned 1320 with actual value and [0,46], preserve unknown masking and primary evaluation failures

followups.issue: Pointer-order and JS callers add InvReg after pointer decoding has already emitted the primary operand-size/range/undefined diagnostic.
followups.status: fixed in tranche 76; emit only on successful pointer decoding and retain the primary failure

followups.issue: Absolute-address PC-relative decoding rejects provisional displacement of a first-pass unknown forward expression before its target resolves.
followups.status: fixed in tranche 77; defer displacement-range rejection for first-pass unknown/questionable targets; all 14 memory/branch callers verified

followups.issue: ADDC/SUBC and IDXM two-operand decoders silently omit the instruction when neither operand is A.
followups.status: fixed in tranche 79; diagnose required A,mem / mem,A pair before evaluation; all four core families verified, valid bytes preserved

followups.issue: Implicit typed DATA/IO address paths check only the upper limit; a typed -1 becomes 0xffff and corrupts the whole instruction word while assembly succeeds.
followups.status: fixed in tranche 81; reject known negative typed addresses with positioned 1315/full interval, mask unknown provisional negative addresses consistently with existing upper handling; signed immediates and valid endpoint bytes preserved

followups.issue: DecodeAdr stores UInt16 result in signed 16-bit Integer, so data addresses 32768..65535 become negative, bypass >255 rejection and silently truncate to a byte.
followups.status: fixed in tranche 82; use unsigned Word for evaluated addresses; reject the entire unsigned upper domain while preserving valid data/ROM-window encodings

followups.issue: DecodeRel shifts a negative signed displacement left by three when encoding backward short branches, invoking undefined C behavior.
followups.status: fixed in tranche 83; cast to unsigned Word before packing; WSL UBSan reproduced left shift of negative value -1 before the fix and focused tests pass afterward, preceding backward bytes preserved

followups.issue: Regular and bit-test relative branch decoders reject provisional distances of first-pass unknown forward expressions before final symbols resolve.
followups.status: fixed in tranche 84; defer range checks for first-pass unknown/questionable expressions, all six branch callers verified on both CPU address-width families

followups.issue: SETB/CLRB/BBC/BBS callers append InvAddrMode after DecodeBitAdr has already reported failed address/bit expression evaluation.
followups.status: fixed in tranche 86; bit parser reports missing separator itself, callers encode only on parser success and retain primary type/range/symbol failures

followups.issue: Regular and bit relative branches reject first-pass unknown forward-expression provisional distances before final targets resolve.
followups.status: fixed in tranche 87; defer unknown/questionable displacement checks in both decoders; all 14 branch aliases/callers verified

followups.issue: MOVW leaves OpSize=1 across instructions; CMP then evaluates byte immediates as words, emits an extra byte for CMP A,#1 and accepts/truncates CMP R0,#256.
followups.status: fixed in tranche 88; reset default operand size at every instruction dispatch, MOVW still selects word mode explicitly; all six CMP immediate addressing forms verified before/after MOVW

followups.issue: DecodeBitAdr uses strchr for its separator, so a colon character literal in the address is split inside its quotes and rejected.
followups.status: fixed in tranche 90; quote-aware separator search accepts character-literal addresses and preserves missing-separator/primary range failures
